cadence: applied to every draft; re-label the back catalog once
first_installment_sketch: The label inventory post: ActivityPub, ATProto, social automation, speculative execution, federation, public-social indexing (the directive's list) each tagged with its real current label from SHIPPING / PROTOTYPE / EXPERIMENT / RESEARCH / DESIGN HYPOTHESIS. inputs: its verified implementation state: shipping, prototype, experiment, research, or hypothesis
name: PRODUCT VS RESEARCH LABELS
outputs: the visible label set in the style guide
purpose: Separate product claims from research claims with visible labels so no reader mistakes an impressive harvest for something shipping.
template: Visible labels: SHIPPING / PROTOTYPE / EXPERIMENT / RESEARCH / DESIGN HYPOTHESIS. Every consequential claim carries one. Rule: the label comes from verified implementation state, never from the ambition of the paragraph around it. Re-label the back catalog once, then enforce at draft review. The label travels with the claim when it is quoted or derived into other content.
